title: Fourier coefficients under sign restriction
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on all coordinates outside $J$. Extend the resulting restricted function to the whole cube by using those fixed signs outside $J$ and the input signs on $J$. For any coordinate set $S$, the Fourier coefficient of this extension at $S$ equals the restricted Fourier coefficient at $S$ when $S\subseteq J$, and equals zero otherwise.
